integrity.method: Exact algebra and complete finite incidence-matrix enumeration; executable verification code included. Literature overlap comparisons are best-knowledge and have residual risks.

scientific_limitations: Connected simple binary plant-pollinator networks; independent homogeneous pollinator losses; plant-loss probability means loss of every adjacent pollinator; maximum matching is a one-to-one service-capacity surrogate. Complete minimality only through eight total vertices; neither a field prediction nor a large-network classification.
title: Pairwise Coextinction Laws Do Not Determine Matching Capacity: A Sharp Nine-Species Boundary
